docs.abstract: NSIDC provides this data set to aid in the investigations of the variability and trends of sea ice cover. Ice cover in these data are indicated by sea ice concentration: the percentage of the ocean surface covered by ice.
docs.title: Sea Ice Trends and Climatologies from SMMR and SSM/I-SSMIS, Version 1
origin: National Snow and Ice Data Center
